run_multi_instance_data_parallel: run a multi instance data parallel vLLM engine with AsyncLLMEngine and AsyncEngineArgs
create_async_engine_args: create AsyncEngineArgs with data parallel size, address, rpc port, and model configuration
generate_with_data_parallel_rank: generate text using AsyncLLMEngine.generate with a specific data parallel rank target
setup_background_logging_thread: setup a background logging thread that periodically calls engine do_log_stats at intervals
configure_sampling_params: configure SamplingParams with temperature, top_p, and max_tokens for text generation
